items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: And Red Rodney was around, and there were some other people around. But Bird was so dominant a force that I didn't have time to listen to nobody else.

ctx.x: What do you remember specifically (we have talked about this a little bit) about the Philadelphia days, and the Downbeat club and that whole period?

Well, in that area... See, this is funny, because Bird was over in Philly at the same time I was over there. He really so much to say, that I couldn't see any farther than what Bird was doing -- although they had cats who could play. Like, they had a tenor player there who played pretty good, but I can't think of his name. And Red Rodney was around, and there were some other people around. But Bird was so dominant a force that I didn't have time to listen to nobody else. I would listen to Bird!
